items.source: Determine the Content-Type of the response based on the "Content-Type" header or otherwise default to MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM.
items.translation: 根据"Content-Type"标头确定响应的 Content-Type，否则默认为MediaType.APPLICATION_OCTET_STREAM。

items.source: Response extractor that uses the given entity converters to convert the response into a type T.
items.translation: 使用给定的实体转换器将响应转换为类型T的响应提取器。

items.source: Extract data from the given ClientHttpResponse and return it.
items.translation: 从给定的ClientHttpResponse中提取数据并返回。
